title: The total-object functor of two-step filtered module complexes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $DF_2(R)$ be the localization of two-step filtered module complexes [def-trf-two-step-filtered-module-derived]. Let $D(R)$ be the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Forgetting a pair $K^\prime\hookrightarrow K$ means taking $K$, and forgetting a commutative square means taking its total chain map, followed by ordinary derived localization. Filtered chain homotopies give equal total derived maps. The resulting functor on the filtered homotopy category inverts filtered quasi-isomorphisms: a map which is a quasi-isomorphism on the subcomplex and quotient is one on the total complex. Define $\omega:DF_2(R)\to D(R)$ as the canonical localization lift of this functor, with this chain normalization.
